analyst_view.overall: A top-of-the-table game: Barcelona lead La Liga on 30 points and Atlético are second on 28, with Atlético on six straight league wins and the best defence (8 conceded), and Barcelona the top scorers (46). Atlético lost 2-0 at home to Bayern on Tuesday; Barcelona beat Aston Villa 3-0 but lost Rodri to a hamstring injury. Barcelona are also without Olmo, Bardghji and Espart, with Koundé out; Eric García and Christensen are back. Atlético miss Cristian Romero.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals, close to Barcelona's average. Atlético have the league's best defence and Simeone's sides tend to tighten up in big games, and Barcelona lose Rodri and Olmo in midfield. We lean a little below the site, though Barcelona's scoring (46 in 11) keeps it from being much lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, split almost evenly. Barcelona should have more of the ball, and Atlético will sit in a compact block at times, which tends to give the possession side corners. The near-even split may slightly undersell Barcelona, but the total looks fine.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards: the derby boost is mostly cancelled by referee Javier Alberola Rojas's record. With first place at stake before the international break and Atlético looking to stop Barcelona's runners, this has the ingredients of a niggly game. We lean higher.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots, with Barcelona taking most. That fits the expected shape: Barcelona dominate the ball, Atlético counter through Julián Álvarez. We stay with the site.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target. Atlético rarely give up clear chances (8 conceded in 11), and Barcelona are without Olmo and Rodri, so we lean slightly below the site.
